summary: Learn to design indicators, verify service results, and manage outcome-linked payments. Explore the course and practical curriculum.
lede: Results-based contracting links service-contract payments and management to defined, verifiable outcomes. This training is for procurement and contract managers, programme directors, and service commissioners who need to specify outcomes and manage contracts using evidence; it develops skills in setting measurable indicators and targets, planning verification, and linking payment decisions to performance. Exercises also cover performance reporting and documented responses when providers miss targets.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who specify, procure, administer, monitor, or commission service contracts where payment depends on delivery results.
modules: Theory of Change and Results Chains
prerequisites: Prior experience in procurement, contract management, programme delivery, monitoring and evaluation, or service commissioning is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet-based exercises; no specialist software installation is specified.
